Current release queue, 7 October 2026: release-1.1; milestone-film.
Plan: docs/refactor/RELEASE-QUEUE.md. Mote remains authoritative; one primary agent and at most one helper.

Reconciliation: Acceptance retained; this audit did not run its proposed tests.

Remaining / next action: Add exact anchored film mention positions and retained Held/ambiguous/refused gaps; keep existing text APIs and forbid narrowing, mixed total order and root fallback. Use the preserved September film phase plan and qualify the exact downstream consumer; no scientific accuracy follows.

Release tags schedule work; they do not establish completion or empirical qualification. Use current AGENTS.md for ownership, scoped gates and exact-SHA review; old fleet roles, timers and fixed gate task counts are historical. Keep the original scientific preregistration, denominators, admission and sealed-test rules below.

Retained acceptance and design context:

Governing plan: docs/plans/2026-09-20-film-compiler-phase-plan.md
Phase-plan ticket: bd-01M2TAGST4EBFR1HM9Q3EWSYAH
Film parent: bd-01M2T32SGVJXR2RT3RTS2DCN9P

This ticket is an executable child created from the cold-reviewed filing payload. Its blocking edges are authoritative; parent relation is organizational only.

Acceptance criteria:
1. Record ADR/API inventory for additive MentionCoordinate/AnchoredMentionPosition and the film forms result. Existing MentionPosition constructor/fields/order and MentionForms text returns remain compatible.
2. Checked anchored positions retain full bundle, axis, Long bounds, proposal ordinal/ID and concept; own-atlas ordering is deterministic for point/interval ties and values beyond Int.MaxValue. No mixed text/tick total order or narrowing.
3. Film forms read only the bound proposal text as linguistic features; typed physical support drives film IDs and positions. Distinct support remains distinguishable and unordered input permutation is stable.
4. NarratedWorld proposals have a lawful positive control. Held, ambiguous and refused placements emit typed retained gaps, never root fallback; affected relations gap while independent root clauses remain possible.
5. Named narrowing/order/identity and Held-to-root mutations fail. Existing text quoted/embedded placement and mention-form courts are unchanged.

Required gates:
- Separate committed-source SD6 cold review with findings resolved.
- Named compiled mutations and independent accepting controls; compile-door witnesses clean both Compile and Test and prove both recompilations.
- Clean exact-candidate standalone provider compileAll/testAll, separate format checks, frozen S0 values and applicable WOG backend byte court.
- Executable docs examples for public API changes; exact-pinned storyatlas consumer suite when its dependencies or interfaces are touched.
- Local evidence and commits only; no push or scientific/CI qualification implied.

Scope limits:
- No anchored Held contexts in this first route; no license choice or standalone fake model compiler court.

Plan sections: §3, §6.
